newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-HILL MAY EVEN END UP AT FERRARI, HINTS ECCLESTONE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-HILL MAY EVEN END UP AT FERRARI, HINTS ECCLESTONE.

text.p: Briton Damon Hill could even up as a Ferrari driver, alongside his old rival double world champion Michael Schumacher, according to the latest gossip in the rumour-filled Monza paddock at the Italian Grand Prix.

Championship leader Hill, dropped by Williams who are to replace him with Heinz-Harald Frentzen of Germany at the end of the season, is searching for a team and has been linked with Benetton, McLaren and Jordan.

But Formula One ringmaster Bernie Ecclestone said on Sunday he could end up at any one of the three leading teams, other than Williams. He said: "He could go to Ferrari...Why not? All the great teams have had the best drivers in the past."

Ecclestone refused to add any further comment on Hill's future, the subject of massive speculation at the weekend. He said he hoped to see him join a front-running team after winning the championship.
